title: The Boastful Rooster: Why True Champions Are Humble!

lines.text: Reggie the red rooster strutted on the barnyard fence, puffing out his glossy chest!
lines.caps: Reggie the red rooster strutted on the barnyard *FENCE, | puffing out his glossy *CHEST!

lines.text: I have the loudest crow, the brightest feathers, and the highest jumps in town! he bragged!
lines.caps: I have the loudest crow, the brightest *FEATHERS, | and the highest jumps in town! he *BRAGGED!

lines.text: Whenever his friends made great paintings or built castles, Reggie criticized them!
lines.caps: Whenever his friends made great *PAINTINGS | or built castles, Reggie criticized *THEM!

lines.text: Nobody likes playing with someone who always insists they are better than everyone!
lines.caps: Nobody likes playing with someone who always insists *THEY | are better than *EVERYONE!

lines.text: At the county fair race, Reggie tripped over his own big spurs and landed in mud!
lines.caps: At the county fair race, Reggie tripped over his own big *SPURS | and landed in *MUD!

lines.text: Instead of laughing at him, his barnyard friends helped him up and cleaned his feathers!
lines.caps: Instead of laughing at him, his barnyard friends *HELPED | him up and cleaned his *FEATHERS!

lines.text: Reggie blushed and realized true greatness means lifting others up with cheer!
lines.caps: Reggie blushed and realized true *GREATNESS | means lifting others up with *CHEER!

lines.text: Be humble, cheer for your teammates, and let your kindness speak for itself!
lines.caps: Be humble, cheer for your *TEAMMATES, | and let your kindness speak for *ITSELF!

lines.text: Cheer for your friends and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
